summary.text: Joe Spica is the Democratic candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 35 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Rebecca Edgeworth.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Las Vegas and has been a Culinary Union member and shop steward for 15 years.

paragraphs.text: Spica said in his Ballotpedia survey that he is a husband and father of three boys.

He said he sits on the Culinary Union's Contract Negotiations Committee, Tip Compliance Board and Patient Advocacy Board for the Culinary Health Centers, and that as a contract negotiator he has bargained with large Nevada resort companies.
Spica listed lower utility bills among his key messages, saying he opposes the new demand charge for NV Energy customers and wants it repealed.
He also wrote that housing in Nevada is out of control and cited the share of family homes owned by corporations or hedge funds.
